roadmap.title: Campaign
roadmap.description: Use one campaign save. Complete both Rune Trials in every mission from Argent Facility through Lazarus Labs before starting replay cleanup. Collect upgrades and finish mission challenges as you go.

roadmap.title: Campaign cleanup
roadmap.description: Keep the campaign save and replay missions for missing figures, Data Logs, upgrade points and challenges. Finish mod masteries and Rune upgrades.

roadmap.title: Ultra-Nightmare and Arcade
roadmap.description: Clear The UAC on a separate Ultra-Nightmare save. Earn the Arcade ratings, medals and pickups.

roadmap.title: SnapMap
roadmap.description: Finish both tutorial sets, publish a template map and play five published maps.

roadmap.title: Multiplayer
roadmap.description: Use public matches for wins, equipment kills and performance challenges. Work through levels and Echelons to unlock the required armor pieces.

achievements.description: Defeat the Cyberdemon in the campaign.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Cyberdemon in the campaign.

steps.text: At the end of @loc{Lazarus Labs}, defeat both phases of the @enemy{Cyberdemon} fight.

achievements.description: Defeat the Hell Guards in the campaign.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Hell Guards in the campaign.

steps.text: In @loc{The Necropolis}, damage the first @enemy{Hell Guard} when its shield drops, then defeat the pair in the second phase.

achievements.description: Defeat the Spider Mastermind in the campaign.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Spider Mastermind in the campaign.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Spider Mastermind} at the end of @loc{Argent D'Nur}. Aim at the brain and climb a pillar when the floor becomes electrified.

achievements.description: Complete the first mission of the campaign
achievements.summary: Finish The UAC in the campaign.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The UAC}, the opening campaign mission, on your chosen difficulty.

achievements.description: Enter Hell during the campaign.
achievements.summary: Enter Hell during the campaign.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Argent Energy Tower} mission to enter Hell.

achievements.description: Complete the campaign on 'I'm Too Young to Die', 'Hurt Me Plenty', 'Ultra Violence', or 'Nightmare'.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on I'm Too Young to Die, Hurt Me Plenty, Ultra Violence, or Nightmare.

steps.text: Finish the story on @mechanic{I'm Too Young to Die} or another listed difficulty.

achievements.description: Complete The UAC on Ultra-Nightmare
achievements.summary: Finish The UAC on Ultra-Nightmare difficulty.

guide.context: Ultra-Nightmare has no checkpoints; dying means starting again.

steps.text: After your main campaign, create a separate save and choose @mechanic{Ultra-Nightmare}.
Finish @loc{The UAC}. Use charged pistol shots at range and take the shotgun's @mechanic{Explosive Shot} at the Field Drone.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies using the Chainsaw
achievements.summary: Use the Chainsaw to kill 50 campaign enemies.

steps.text: Spend @item{Chainsaw} fuel on enemies throughout the campaign until you reach 50 kills.

achievements.description: Earn the Mastery for a weapon mod
achievements.summary: Complete the mastery challenge for one weapon mod.

steps.text: Buy every upgrade for a @mechanic{weapon mod} with weapon points, then finish the mastery challenge shown for that mod.

achievements.description: Earn the Masteries for all weapon mods
achievements.summary: Complete the mastery challenges for every weapon mod.

steps.text: Find the @item{Field Drones} to obtain the remaining mods. Earn weapon points from combat, secrets, and mission tasks.
Buy all upgrades on each mod, then complete each mod's mastery challenge. Use mission replay on the same save to finish the counters.

achievements.description: Acquire all weapon mods
achievements.summary: Obtain every weapon mod in the campaign.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Full View} in the Praetor Suit's Area-Scanning Technology category to reveal collectible markers.
Visit the @item{Field Drones} marked on each mission map and select a mod you do not own. Check mission select for uncollected drones and replay those missions.

achievements.description: Find all Data Logs
achievements.summary: Collect all 49 campaign Data Logs.

steps.text: Unlock @mechanic{Full View} in the Praetor Suit's Area-Scanning Technology category and pick up the Data Logs shown on mission maps.
Check the pause menu's @mechanic{Codex} for missing entries and replay the matching missions on your existing save.

achievements.description: Use explosive barrels to kill 100 enemies
achievements.summary: Kill 100 enemies with explosive barrels.

steps.text: Shoot @item{explosive barrels} when weak enemies gather beside them. Keep using barrels across missions until you have 100 kills.

achievements.description: Find all Collectibles
achievements.summary: Collect all 26 Doomguy figures in the campaign.

guide.context: One-way passages can block figures during a mission. Replay that mission on the same save to recover anything left behind.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 1
collectibles.method: Climb the crates beside the corpse holding the blue key, then climb onto the rock ledge.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 2
collectibles.method: In the later demon-filled alcove, take the tunnel on the left.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 3
collectibles.method: At the rear of the outdoor area, climb the bloodstained crate and platforms to the roof. Enter the small room across the rooftop.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 4
collectibles.method: Climb the crates beside the corpse on the left side of the VEGA room. Take the figure from the space above before using the onward door.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 5
collectibles.method: Near the yellow-key corpse, look below the edge facing the pipes that pour molten metal. Drop onto the platform underneath.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 6
collectibles.method: Beyond the yellow door, climb the crates beside the two robotic arms. Take the figure inside the middle crate.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 7
collectibles.method: Destroy the filter near the outdoor blue barrier. Drop through the opened shutter and climb the crates to the central platform.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 8
collectibles.method: Return to the crates near the blue barrier and climb up. Follow the right-hand path into an opening, climb the crate, and follow the building's left edge to the room with the figure.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 9
collectibles.method: After the maintenance-tunnel Elite Guard and Data Log, take the right-hand tunnel. Climb the ledges and jump past the moving machinery into the opening with the flashing green light. Drop down and look left.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 10
collectibles.method: Climb one level above the spinning central core to the four red electrical beams. Drop carefully onto the ledge beneath one of the two upward platforms.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 11
collectibles.method: After using the yellow skull and clearing the next arena, climb the newly formed rocks and activate the skull. Enter the opened door and turn right before taking the green portal.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 12
collectibles.method: After the blue-door section and the next large demon arena, go toward the far staircase. Check the small platform inside its corner as you climb.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 13
collectibles.method: During the opening climb on green-lit ledges, pull the lever behind the crates. Drop one platform and face the classic secret-room entrance; take the path on its left.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 14
collectibles.method: Clear the arena with the small shuttle and enter the nearby door. Face the objective and climb into the little room in the upper-left corner.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 15
collectibles.method: After opening the outdoor blue barrier, climb the central rocks. From the upper rock, double-jump to the small platform beside the two pipes on the right. Climb the pipes into the gap.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 16
collectibles.method: Enter Prototype Lab 1 before going into the BFG room. Climb the central machine into the shaft high on the right, then follow the shaft.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 17
collectibles.method: After the large battle and the broken doorway, turn left behind the first stone slab. Follow the passage left to its end before taking the elevator.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 18
collectibles.method: In the room with the large central shard and its barrier, go upstairs on the right. Press the red wall light among the green lights to open the hiding place.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 19
collectibles.method: After the green portal, turn right, then right up the stairs, then right again. Reach the opposite corner and kill the demons to open the figure's gate.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 20
collectibles.method: After collecting the previous figure, take the next portal and locate the armor overhead. Climb one of the side corners, then jump across to the high room on the right.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 21
collectibles.method: After using both skull keys, follow the tunnel to the broken platforms. At the edge of the last large platform, look down and drop to the smaller ledge.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 22
collectibles.method: Beyond the Field Drone, shoot the red symbol on the giant skull's forehead. Continue through the next fight, then turn left after the stairs to retrieve the released figure.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 23
collectibles.method: Outside the first airlock, climb the platform and drop to its right. Follow the pipe to the green-lit door. Take the first left inside and check the shaft edge.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 24
collectibles.method: Find the blue-key corpse behind the floor hatch, then pass through the blue doors to the Elite Guard. Drop down the shaft on the guard's left, turn around, and check the bottom of the yellow shaft before entering the building.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 25
collectibles.method: At the second Wraith soul area, take the left staircase. Search behind the broken steps halfway up.

collectibles.name: Doomguy figure 26
collectibles.method: Defeat the Spider Mastermind to receive the last figure automatically.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade Health, Armor, or Ammo capacity
achievements.summary: Maximize one campaign capacity: Health, Armor, or Ammo.

steps.text: Spend @item{Argent Cells} on the same capacity until Health, Armor, or Ammo is fully upgraded.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade Health, Armor, and Ammo capacity on a single campaign run.
achievements.summary: Maximize Health, Armor, and Ammo on one campaign save.

steps.text: Collect the campaign's @item{Argent Cells} and spend them until every capacity is full.
Use mission select on that same save to recover missing cells. @warn{Keep this campaign save until all capacity upgrades are complete.}

achievements.description: Earn a Rune
achievements.summary: Earn a campaign Rune by completing its trial.

steps.text: In @loc{Argent Facility}, enter the first @mechanic{Rune Trial} and finish its timed objective.

achievements.description: Earn all Runes
achievements.summary: Earn every campaign Rune by completing all 12 Rune Trials.

guide.context: Use Full View to reveal the trial markers. Runes earned outside normal campaign progression can leave this achievement locked.

steps.text: Complete both Rune Trials in each mission from @loc{Argent Facility} through @loc{Lazarus Labs} as you reach them.
@warn{Finish each trial from its stone inside the campaign. Avoid Rune Trial Select and postpone mission-select cleanup until all 12 Runes are earned.}
If all Runes are present but the achievement stays locked, use a separate new campaign save and earn the 12 Runes again during normal mission progression.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade a Praetor Suit category.
achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade in one Praetor Suit category.

steps.text: Take Praetor Tokens from @item{Elite Guards} and spend them on one suit category until that category is complete.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade all Praetor Suit categories on a single campaign run.
achievements.summary: Buy every Praetor Suit upgrade on one campaign save.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Full View} to find @item{Elite Guards} on the mission maps and collect their Praetor Tokens.
Buy all upgrades across the five suit categories. Replay missions for missing guards on the same save before starting another campaign.

achievements.description: Complete all Challenges for a single mission.
achievements.summary: Finish every challenge in one campaign mission.

steps.text: In @loc{Resource Operations}, stagger Possessed and Glory Kill them from five different angles or body targets. Reload the checkpoint if you need more enemies.
Kill two Possessed with one shotgun trigger pull. Explosive Shot can catch the pair together.
Find three secrets in the mission. Check all three challenge counters before leaving.

achievements.description: Perform 200 Glory Kills
achievements.summary: Perform 200 campaign Glory Kills.

steps.text: Weaken demons until they flash, then approach and press melee to perform @mechanic{Glory Kills}. Accumulate 200 across the campaign.

achievements.description: Glory Kill all common enemy types in the campaign.
achievements.summary: Perform a Glory Kill on every common campaign enemy type.

guide.context: Weaken each enemy until it flashes, then use melee at close range. Use mission replay if an enemy type was missed.

collectibles.name: Imp
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Imp}.

collectibles.name: Possessed
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Possessed}.

collectibles.name: Possessed Soldier
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Possessed Soldier}.

collectibles.name: Possessed Engineer
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Possessed Engineer}.

collectibles.name: Possessed Security
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Possessed Security}.

collectibles.name: Cacodemon
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Cacodemon}.

collectibles.name: Mancubus
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Mancubus}.

collectibles.name: Unwilling
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Unwilling}.

collectibles.name: Revenant
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Revenant}.

collectibles.name: Hell Razer
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Hell Razer}.

collectibles.name: Hell Knight
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Hell Knight}.

collectibles.name: Baron of Hell
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Baron of Hell}.

collectibles.name: Summoner
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Summoner}.

collectibles.name: Pinky
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill on a staggered @enemy{Pinky}.

achievements.description: Kill 150 enemies while using Power Ups
achievements.summary: Kill 150 campaign enemies while power-ups are active.

steps.text: Pick up a glowing @mechanic{power-up} in a combat arena and kill enemies before the effect ends. Add kills with later power-ups until the total reaches 150.

achievements.description: Upgrade a Rune
achievements.summary: Complete the upgrade challenge for one campaign Rune.

steps.text: Equip a @mechanic{Rune} and complete the upgrade objective displayed for that Rune in the menu.

achievements.description: Upgrade all Runes
achievements.summary: Complete the upgrade challenges for all 12 campaign Runes.

steps.text: Equip Runes with unfinished upgrade objectives and work on the displayed counters.
Switch to other Runes after an upgrade completes. Replay missions on your existing save until all 12 Runes are upgraded.

achievements.description: Complete all Mission Challenges
achievements.summary: Complete every campaign mission challenge.

steps.text: Read the three challenge objectives at the start of each mission after @loc{The UAC}. Complete them before leaving that mission.
For combat counters, reload the checkpoint while the needed enemies remain available. For missed objectives, replay the relevant mission on your campaign save.

In @loc{Advanced Research Complex}, enter both Rune Trial stones during the mission for Double Take. In @loc{Lazarus Labs}, play @mechanic{Demon Destruction} on the office computer before activating the Helix Stone.

For Hold Still in @loc{Argent D'Nur}, keep BFG ammo for the final arena. When two Barons appear, take Quad Damage and fire past the pair so the BFG tendrils hit both. If the single shot fails, reload the checkpoint before the battle ends.

achievements.description: Win a Multiplayer match
achievements.summary: Win one multiplayer match.

steps.text: Join a public multiplayer match and play until you or your team wins.

achievements.description: Reach Level 5 in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Reach multiplayer level 5.

steps.text: Keep completing public multiplayer matches to earn XP until you reach level 5.

achievements.description: Obtain the BFG during the campaign.
achievements.summary: Obtain the BFG during the campaign.

steps.text: Take the @item{BFG} during the story in @loc{Advanced Research Complex}.

achievements.description: Create and publish a SnapMap
achievements.summary: Publish a SnapMap you created.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{SnapMap}, then My SnapMaps → Create Map, and load a template.
Open the editor's pause menu, choose @mechanic{Publish}, and complete the publishing prompts.

achievements.description: Play 5 published SnapMaps
achievements.summary: Play five published SnapMaps.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{SnapMap Community} and choose Popular Maps. Play five different published maps; try another map if the achievement has not appeared.

achievements.description: Complete the SnapMap Basic and Advanced Tutorials
achievements.summary: Finish the Basic and Advanced SnapMap tutorials.

steps.text: Under @mechanic{My SnapMaps}, finish the four tasks in SnapMap Academy: Basic Training and the eight tasks in SnapMap Academy: Advanced.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with the Harvester demon in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Kill 10 multiplayer opponents while playing as the Harvester.

steps.text: Select @enemy{Harvester} as your demon before the match. Demons unlock as you rank up; all are available by rank 44.
Collect a @mechanic{Demon Rune} to transform, then kill opponents until your Harvester total reaches 10 across matches.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with the EMG Mark V Pistol in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Kill 10 multiplayer opponents with the EMG Mark V Pistol.

steps.text: Unlock the @item{EMG Mark V Pistol} as you rank up, then equip it in your weapon loadout.
Use the @item{EMG Mark V Pistol} to finish off 10 opponents in public matches. Kills can span several matches.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies with the Kinetic Mine in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Kill 5 multiplayer opponents with the Kinetic Mine.

steps.text: Unlock the @item{Kinetic Mine} as you rank up, then equip it in your equipment slot.
Use the @item{Kinetic Mine} to finish off 5 opponents in public matches. Kills can span several matches.

achievements.description: Use a taunt from Expansion 1 during a Multiplayer Match
achievements.summary: Use an Expansion 1 taunt during a multiplayer match.

steps.text: In multiplayer customization, equip a taunt marked @mechanic{Expansion 1} and bind it to a taunt key. Use that key during a public match.

achievements.description: Play a Multiplayer Match with a piece of Robotic Armor equipped
achievements.summary: Play a multiplayer match wearing at least one Robotic armor piece.

steps.text: Reach @mechanic{Echelon V} and complete an armor challenge to unlock a Robotic piece, or reach Echelon VII rank 1 for a level-based unlock.
Equip that piece in multiplayer customization and enter a public match.

achievements.description: Detect 20 enemies using the Threat Pulse in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Detect 20 multiplayer opponents with Threat Pulse.

steps.text: Unlock @item{Threat Pulse} through multiplayer ranks and equip it as your equipment.
Activate Threat Pulse near enemy players so the scan detects them through walls. Accumulate 20 detections across public matches.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with the Cacodemon in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Kill 10 multiplayer opponents while playing as the Cacodemon.

steps.text: Select @enemy{Cacodemon} as your demon before the match. Demons unlock as you rank up; all are available by rank 44.
Collect a @mechanic{Demon Rune} to transform, then kill opponents until your Cacodemon total reaches 10 across matches.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with the Reaper in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Kill 10 multiplayer opponents with the Reaper.

steps.text: Unlock the @item{Reaper} as you rank up, then equip it in your weapon loadout.
Use the @item{Reaper} to finish off 10 opponents in public matches. Kills can span several matches.

achievements.description: Play a Multiplayer Match with a piece of Cyber-Demonic armor equipped
achievements.summary: Play a multiplayer match wearing at least one Cyber-Demonic armor piece.

steps.text: Reach @mechanic{Echelon VIII} and complete a Cyber-Demonic armor challenge, or reach Echelon X rank 1 for a level-based piece.
Equip the unlocked Cyber-Demonic piece and join a public multiplayer match.

achievements.description: Use a taunt from Expansion 2 during a Multiplayer Match
achievements.summary: Use an Expansion 2 taunt during a multiplayer match.

steps.text: In multiplayer customization, equip a taunt marked @mechanic{Expansion 2} and bind it to a taunt key. Use that key during a public match.

achievements.description: Earn every medal type in Arcade Mode in one run
achievements.summary: Earn all 14 Arcade medal types during one mission run.

guide.context: Use Advanced Research Complex in Arcade Mode. Every medal must come from the same attempt; you do not need to finish the mission after earning the last one.

collectibles.name: Barrel Kill
collectibles.method: Kill a demon with an exploding barrel.

collectibles.name: Glory Kill
collectibles.method: Perform a Glory Kill from beside a staggered demon.

collectibles.name: Super-Kill
collectibles.method: Kill at least six demons together; use the BFG on a group.

collectibles.name: Multi-Kill
collectibles.method: Kill three to five demons together.

collectibles.name: Death From Above
collectibles.method: Jump directly above a staggered demon and press melee.

collectibles.name: Head Shot
collectibles.method: Finish a demon with a shot to the head.

collectibles.name: Direct Hit Kill
collectibles.method: Kill a demon with a direct rocket or shotgun Explosive Shot hit.

collectibles.name: Stunned Kill
collectibles.method: Stun a demon with the Plasma Rifle Stun Bomb, then kill the demon.

collectibles.name: Mid-Air Kill
collectibles.method: Kill a demon while that demon is airborne.

collectibles.name: Triple Hit
collectibles.method: Land every shot of a Combat Shotgun Charged Burst on one demon.

collectibles.name: Extra Life
collectibles.method: Pick up a floating Doomguy extra life.

collectibles.name: Gold Relic Bonus
collectibles.method: Shoot a mine and take its relic while the relic is gold.

collectibles.name: Silver Relic Bonus
collectibles.method: Destroy a fresh mine. Allow its dropped relic to become silver, then collect the relic.

collectibles.name: Bronze Relic Bonus
collectibles.method: Destroy a fresh mine. Allow its dropped relic to become bronze, then collect the relic.

achievements.description: Earn a gold rating in Arcade Mode
achievements.summary: Finish an Arcade mission with a Gold rating.

steps.text: Play @loc{The UAC} in Arcade Mode on an easy difficulty. Kill enemies quickly to maintain your score multiplier.
Collect extra lives and grab relics promptly while they are gold. Finish the mission with enough points for the Gold rating.

achievements.description: Collect 20 bonus lives or relics in Arcade Mode
achievements.summary: Collect 20 extra lives or relics in Arcade Mode.

steps.text: In Arcade Mode, collect floating @item{Doomguy extra lives} and shoot mines to release relics. Pick up 20 of these rewards across your runs.

achievements.description: Perform a MultiKill with the Spectre demon in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Earn a multiplayer MultiKill while playing as the Spectre.

steps.text: Choose @enemy{Spectre} as your demon and collect a Demon Rune in a public match.
Charge through two opponents standing close together to kill both in quick succession.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with the Spectre demon in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Kill 10 multiplayer opponents while playing as the Spectre.

steps.text: Select @enemy{Spectre} as your demon before the match. Demons unlock as you rank up; all are available by rank 44.
Collect a @mechanic{Demon Rune} to transform, then kill opponents until your Spectre total reaches 10 across matches.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with the Grenade Launcher in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Kill 10 multiplayer opponents with the Grenade Launcher.

steps.text: Unlock the @item{Grenade Launcher} as you rank up, then equip it in your weapon loadout.
Use the @item{Grenade Launcher} to finish off 10 opponents in public matches. Kills can span several matches.

achievements.description: Play a Multiplayer Match with a piece of Evil Cultist armor equipped
achievements.summary: Play a multiplayer match wearing at least one Evil Cultist armor piece.

steps.text: Unlock an @item{Evil Cultist} armor piece while progressing through multiplayer ranks, equip the piece, and enter a public match.

achievements.description: Use a taunt from Expansion 3 during a Multiplayer Match
achievements.summary: Use an Expansion 3 taunt during a multiplayer match.

steps.text: In multiplayer customization, equip a taunt marked @mechanic{Expansion 3} and bind it to a taunt key. Use that key during a public match.

achievements.description: Complete a tracked challenge in a Multiplayer Match
achievements.summary: Finish a tracked challenge during a multiplayer match.

steps.text: Open multiplayer @mechanic{Challenges} and select an unfinished challenge to track. Check that a golden eye marks the selected challenge.
Complete that challenge's requirement in a public multiplayer match.

achievements.description: Earn a Gold Rating in a Multiplayer Match
achievements.summary: Receive a Gold performance rating in a multiplayer match.

steps.text: Join a public multiplayer match. Earn points through kills and the mode's objectives until your performance rating reaches @mechanic{Gold}.
Finish the match and check the rating in the results.

achievements.description: Unlock all Multiplayer Runes
achievements.summary: Unlock every multiplayer Rune.

steps.text: Earn multiplayer XP until you reach @mechanic{rank 44}, which unlocks the final Rune.
